title: DATEADD moves a whole month to the whole month before, whatever its length
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 2, 29 ) )

source.quote: If the <Dates> argument includes all the days in April (30 rows), the result for the previous month includes all the days in March (31 days).
source.supports: a whole month becomes the whole target month

source.quote: If all the days of the month are selected, then the entire month is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a fully selected month moves as a whole month

derivation: All 29 days of February 2024 are selected, so the result is all of January 2024: 31 days from 29. Sales in January 2024: 300.
